name: China, in the making 🇨🇳
subtitle: Guangzhou to Shanghai · working draft with Changsha
overview:
Flights are booked. City stays and dates are provisional.
Route: Guangzhou → Changsha → Zhangjiajie → Chongqing → Chengdu → Xi'an → Beijing → Shanghai.
Prioritise geography, travel times, weather, and the Chongqing drone show before confirming hotels.
Potential extras: Macau, Shenzhen, Chenzhou, Furong Ancient Town.
checklist:
Book hotels after route is settled
Check train schedules and station locations
Confirm drone show schedule and viewing locations
Check bungee/sky ladder availability and weather
Confirm meal arrangements
Export JSON backup and share with travel companion

stays.name: Guangzhou
stays.ideas: Canton Tower, Pearl River, clothing markets, tech markets, Xuelei Fragrance Museum, Linglong night market, Shenzhen or Macau possible day trip

stays.name: Changsha
stays.area: Near Wuyi Square or Huangxing Road
stays.ideas: Explore Changsha, food streets, possible Orange Isle

stays.name: Zhangjiajie
stays.area: Wulingyuan or city centre: decide based on mountains vs Tianmen
stays.ideas: Avatar forest, Bailong Elevator, Tianmen Mountain, 999 steps, Grand Canyon Glass Bridge, Bungy China, Qixing Sky Ladder, 72 Wonder Tower, Furong Ancient Town

stays.name: Chongqing
stays.ideas: Drone show 20/21/22 November (verify schedule), 1949 Theatre, Hongyadong, Nanbin Road, Liziba, Fotuguan, TESTBED2, Eling Park, Wulong Karst, Raffles City Skywalk, Luo Han Temple, Kuixing Square, Great Hall, Ciqikou

stays.name: Chengdu
stays.ideas: Panda Base, People’s Park tea culture, SKP Tower of Vitality, mega spa, Wuhou Memorial, optional Dujiangyan, Zhongshuge bookstore, Mount Qingcheng, Sanxingdui Museum

stays.name: Xi'an
stays.ideas: City Wall, Bell Tower, Terracotta Warriors if feasible

stays.name: Beijing
stays.ideas: Great Wall (Mutianyu / Jinshanling), Forbidden City, traditional hutongs, CCTV HQ

stays.name: Shanghai
stays.ideas: The Bund, North Bund, Yu Garden, Lujiazui, Wukang Road, French Concession, Zhongshu bookstore, Long Bar, Apoli Itabakery

activities.title: Fly London Heathrow → Wuhan (CZ608)
activities.notes: Overnight flight; arrives Wuhan 12 Nov 12:05 local time

2026-11-12.overview: Arrive Guangzhou in late afternoon; hotel transfer and easy evening.

activities.title: Land in Guangzhou
activities.notes: Allow time for arrivals and hotel transfer

2026-12-02.overview: Last day in Shanghai. Leave enough time to reach Pudong airport.
